title: Decommission
description: A specific serialized unit's physical life ends - administered, destroyed, expired or withdrawn (GS1 EPCIS 2.0's own decommissioning bizStep; DSCSA/FMD unit lifecycle). Never patient-linked: the issuer is the administering or destroying entity as a business, never a patient (spec Sec.1, Sec.9, Sec.11). A subject that already carries a decommission reappearing afterward is a structural contradiction a client or monitor can flag.
